Package com.egradx.auth.web

Class EgradxAuthController

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.web.EgradxAuthController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/egradx/auth") public class EgradxAuthController extends Object
The HTTP-facing side of EgradxAuthService, for apps that want auth over REST rather than calling the service directly in-process. Targets a Spring MVC (servlet) host app — there's no WebFlux equivalent yet, mirroring the existing egradx-web-security/egradx-webflux-security split.
